# ERD Online

> The Git + Figma for database design: versioned ER diagrams, diffs, and live collaboration. Open-source (MIT).

Not ChatSQL. Not a one-shot “generate an ERD” product. Agents may read the same `projectJSON` the canvas uses; humans still approve versions.

- Product: https://www.erdonline.com/
- Demo (no login): https://www.erdonline.com/demo
- Docs: https://doc.erdonline.com/docs/guide/what-is-erd-online/

## MCP (secondary)

Mint a PAT (the public Demo is not a PAT). Paste into Cursor `~/.cursor/mcp.json`. Full steps: https://doc.erdonline.com/docs/guide/api-and-mcp/

English: https://doc.erdonline.com/en/docs/guide/api-and-mcp/

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "erdonline": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "--package",
        "https://github.com/erdonline/erdonline/releases/download/mcp-v0.1.0/erdonline-mcp-0.1.0.tgz",
        "erd-mcp"
      ],
      "env": {
        "ERD_API_URL": "https://erdonline-production.up.railway.app",
        "ERD_PAT": "erd_pat_…"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Self-host: set `ERD_API_URL` to `http://127.0.0.1:9502`.
